title: Temperature correction of the substrate removal rate in aerated lagoons

symbols.definition: overall substrate removal rate (from Table 5-12, 0.6-0.8 per day on a soluble BOD basis at 20ºC)
temperature of the lagoon (printed only as the exponent and the subscript)

applicability: Gives lagoon substrate removal rate values at temperatures other than 20ºC for facultative aerated lagoons.
notes: Both factors are printed with K in parentheses on each side, e.g. (K)T°C.
The 1.035 factor is printed with a superscript (T-20).
